answer: Every velvet has a workshop behind it, every delta a ledger, every copper a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. Name the threshold Clockmaker hourglass mark struck within the observatory: it admits each hourglass is a measured beat rate and a master signature and nothing else, and it remembers every face it has seen. A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own. No mask rides free: 120 POA and 20 minutes each, which is 21720 POA and 3620 minutes for 181. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has ever struck one.
